name: KU Leuven
tuitionNote: Bachelor of European Studies only (non-EEA). Fees are programme-specific; e.g. social sciences master 5613.10 EUR.
applicationDeadlines: Non-EEA: Dutch-taught 1 Feb; English-taught vary by programme (BAES 1 Apr 2026); final 22 Sep 2027
scholarshipsForInternational: Faculty fee waivers for non-EEA from eligible countries, e.g. Faculty of Science master pays 3252.72 EUR in 2026-27 instead of full fee.
notes: No university-wide fee page found; IELTS/TOEFL differ per programme so left empty.

name: Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München
tuitionNote: No tuition figure on fetched page; semester fee EUR 97 (WS 2026/27) charged to all students.
applicationDeadlines: 15 July (winter semester), 15 January (summer semester); no late submissions
notes: Proof of German required (English-taught only some master/doctoral); no scholarship page fetched; IELTS/TOEFL not applicable.

name: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
tuitionNote: Overseas UG fee set by programme tier, 2026/27 table lists GBP 28,900 to 39,900 (tiers 28900/30700/32100/35700/39900); no single figure.
scholarshipsForInternational: Range of bursaries and scholarships for Overseas students incl. LSE Access to Education Scholarships; number, value, eligibility vary yearly.
notes: IELTS 7.0 each component; TOEFL 100 (old scale) w/ component minimums. BSc Economics 2027/28 overseas fee GBP 41,900.

name: Kyoto University
tuitionNote: Annual undergraduate tuition; plus admission fee JPY 282,000 and exam fee JPY 17,000. Year not stated on page.
applicationDeadlines: Kyoto iUP (Oct 2027 entry): 2 Nov to 3 Dec 2026, 5 pm JST
scholarshipsForInternational: Kyoto iUP: full admission fee waiver, full/partial tuition waivers, allowance up to JPY 120,000/month in 6-month preparatory course.
notes: IELTS/TOEFL are for English-taught Kyoto iUP only; other programmes taught in Japanese. Master/PhD not verified.

name: KAIST
tuitionNote: Main campus undergraduate annual tuition (3,433,000 per semester); waived by KAIST Scholarship for admitted intl students. Year not stated.
applicationDeadlines: 2027 admissions: Early 22 Oct 2026; Regular 14 Jan 2027 (fall); early track also spring 2027
scholarshipsForInternational: Tuition waived for 8 semesters, living allowance 350,000 KRW/month, health insurance; keep GPA above 2.7/4.3. Automatic on admission.
notes: English test minimums and instruction language not found on fetched pages; main page had no content.

name: Brown University
tuitionNote: Full-time undergraduate tuition (37,284 per semester); mandatory fees listed separately. Same for all students.
scholarshipsForInternational: Need-based aid only, no merit awards; need-blind for intl from Class of 2029; meets full demonstrated need if applied at admission.
notes: IELTS 8.0/TOEFL 105 'in most cases' (TOEFL before Jan 2026; new scale 5.5). Deadlines page not found.

name: The University of Auckland
tuitionNote: Estimated 2027 fee, Bachelor of Arts standard, 120 pts full-time; BCom 51,020.40; BSc 49,581.60-60,909.60; excl. student services fee.
scholarshipsForInternational: Intl School Leaver and Foundation Pathway High Achiever awards up to NZD 20,000 toward tuition; Dean's Asia Scholarship covers tuition up to 360 points.
notes: Page showed only 2027/2028 estimates. IELTS no band below 5.5; TOEFL writing 21; some programmes higher.

name: University of Birmingham
tuitionNote: Fetched official pages publish no international UG fee amount; exact fee stated in offer letter; first-year fee fixed for the course.
scholarshipsForInternational: More than GBP 7.5 million in scholarships available for international students (details on scholarships section).
notes: IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80 = lowest group (A), pre-Jan 2026 scale; groups B-D need 6.5-7.0. Fee band page not found (404).

name: University of Warwick
tuitionNote: Overseas UG Band 1 (lowest main band); Band 2 is GBP 35,530; MBChB 32,510 yr1. Fee varies by course band.
scholarshipsForInternational: Scholarship Portal lists scholarships for intl students; no specific awards or amounts on fetched pages.
notes: IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 87 = Band A (courses need 6.0-7.0 / 87-100). Fee page flagged Band 0 oddity. Deadlines not fetched.

name: Duke University
tuitionNote: Undergraduate tuition, same for first-year and returning students; estimated fees extra (3,019 first-year).
applicationDeadlines: ED 2 Nov; RD 4 Jan; financial aid forms RD 1 Feb (2026-27 cycle)
scholarshipsForInternational: Need-based aid only for intl applicants who state aid interest at application (separate pool); 4-year awards auto-renewed; Karsh program linked.
notes: English scores recommended, not required (IELTS 7, TOEFL 100 before Jan 2026; 5.0 after). Test-optional SAT/ACT.
